item.title: 🇷🇺 Atmosphere of mutual understanding and constructive dialogue Ahead of the third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow,
item.description: Atmosphere of mutual understanding and constructive dialogue 🇷🇺 🇨🇬 Ahead of the third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov held a working meeting with Minister of National Defence of the Republic of the Congo Raymond-Zephyren Mbulu. 💬 During the talks, the sides discussed joint bilateral cooperation projects in the defence sphere and further plans for their practical implementation. Commitment to developing constructive dialogue and maintaining a high level of interdepartmental partnership was confirmed. 🤝 The meeting was held in an atmosphere of mutual understanding and demonstrated traditionally friendly character of Russian-Congolese relations. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💥 Blindside hit: Vostok Group servicemen mop up AFU stronghold in Zaporozhye region
item.description: 💥 Blindside hit: Vostok Group servicemen mop up AFU stronghold in Zaporozhye region ▫️ The assaultmen covertly approached the positions from several directions: they used blind zones and approached the fortifications. While one part of the group was distracting the enemy from the front and flanks, the other part approached from behind and mopped up the trenches. 💬 The assaultman with the call sign ‘Stary’ described the combat tactics: ‘You move to the attack target, literally 50 metres, and hide. As far as the manpower concentrates, we advance on command. You enter from the outside, where the enemy can't see you, and begin to suppress him with fire, so he couldn't raise his head. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✈️ Strategic altitude Tu-95ms aircraft crews performed a planned flight over the neutral waters of Bering and Chukchi seas.
item.description: Strategic altitude ✈️ Tu-95ms aircraft crews performed a planned flight over the neutral waters of Bering and Chukchi seas. ⏱️ The flight of the Russian Aerospace Forces' long-range aircraft lasted more than 13 hours and the aircraft were refuelled right in the sky . It was escorted by Su-35s fighter jets. ▫️ At certain stages of the route, the aircraft were escorted by foreign fighter jets. Crews of long-range aviation regularly conduct flights over the neutral waters of the Arctic, the North Atlantic, the Pacific Ocean, Black and Baltic seas. All Russian Aerospace Forces aircraft flights are carried out in strict compliance with international rules on the use of airspace. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Every day, units of the Dnepr Group of Forces conduct engineering reconnaissance and demine main routes to the settlement of Aleshki
item.description: ❗️ Every day, units of the Dnepr Group of Forces conduct engineering reconnaissance and demine main routes to the settlement of Aleshki neutralising explosive objects and trap mines laid by the Armed Forces of Ukraine using unmanned aerial vehicles. ▫️ For more than two years, the Kiev regime daily has been inflicting artillery fire on roads and approaches to the settlement and using UAVs to destroy any motor vehicle. Ukrainian drones remotely mine access routes in order to prevent the evacuation of civilians and block the delivery of food, medicines and socially significant cargoes to the settlement. ▫️ For the last week, since 19 October, the Kiev regime has inflicted 18 artillery strikes and more than 120 UAV strikes against the settlement and its main approaches. ▫️ During the week, the Group's engineering specialists have neutralised more than 300 explosive objects and mines. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30286

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade close to Podsredneye, Prikolotnoye, Doroshenkovo, and Fedorovka (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Khoten, Barilovka, and Nikolskoye.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 300 troops, 19 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades have been hit close to Lesnaya Stenka, Donetskoye (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, Cherkasskoye, and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, 20 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They launched strikes against formations of five mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, and Kondratovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 185 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 33 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and four electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Stepanovka, Krinitsy, Belozerskoye, Shilovka, Starovarvarovka, and Malotaranovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 340 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, one U.S.-made Paladin self-propelled artillery system, and two electronic warfare stations.
👉
